title: Focused Binance market-state 15-minute confirmation
claim: The exact V2 market-state ExtraTrees specification improves 15-minute outright-return MSE over the strongest frozen baseline in the untouched Binance archive period.
mechanism: Short-horizon nonlinear interactions among causal return, range, volume, trade-count, and basket state may persist beyond the development period.
target: Fifteen-minute outright log return for the point-in-time dynamic top-four Binance USDT perpetual basket.
informationSet: Exact nine-field V2 market-state feature schema available at the decision timestamp
primaryBaseline: Strongest frozen zero, historical-mean, persistence, reversal, or market-state Ridge baseline

evidence.summary: The exact audited basket-four 15-minute ExtraTrees specification, feature schema, model, baselines, inference, thresholds, and sealed historical confirmation panel are bound before outcome access. Earlier engineering freezes are superseded and remain preserved.

The candidate improved MSE by 1.087% over the strongest market-only baseline and passed the frozen loss, economic-size, calendar-month, mandatory-asset, and placebo gates, but failed the preregistered dependence-aware significance gate (adjusted p=0.1052 versus 0.05). The predictive claim is rejected without subgroup rescue or retuning.

nextAction: Preserve this rejection and consumed period. Use the result only as hypothesis-generating evidence for a materially distinct candidate with a separately frozen specification and fresh confirmation outcomes.
